title: Urban Cherry Good Cherry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Wick Liquor
description:
Urban Cherry Good Cherry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquidby Wick Liquor is a vibrant blend of dark cherries and fresh strawberries with a zesty kick of lime juice. The punchy cherry flavour is chased by the natural sweetness of ripe strawberries and lifted with a squeeze of tangy lime.
The Wick Liquor Cherry Good Cherry range features a rich cherry base blended with vibrant fruity combinations, available in 100ml nic shot-ready shortfill bottles.
